prompt: Rendered in the style of pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet village market at dawn. On the far left, a weathered wooden cart stands still, its wheels dusty and spokes distinct. Next to the cart, an old woman in a blue shawl sits on a low stool, her posture slumped in rest. A brown dog lies beside her, head resting on its paws, eyes half-closed. In the center foreground, a young boy in a striped shirt points eagerly at a pile of red apples stacked neatly on a crate. The apples are bright against the monochrome background. Behind the boy, a tall man in a wide-brimmed hat looks down at a woven basket he holds in both hands. The basket is empty and textured. To the right of the man, a white goat stands tethered to a post, chewing lazily on a stray leaf. The goat’s horns curve sharply upward. Near the goat, a vendor in a green apron hands a small paper bag to a customer in a grey coat. The customer reaches out with one hand to take the bag. Above them, three colorful fabric banners hang from a rope, fluttering slightly in the morning breeze. The banners are yellow, orange, and pink. Underneath the banners, a clay pot sits on the ground, filled with fresh flowers. The flowers are delicate and sparse. Next to the pot, a black cat watches the goat with intense focus, tail twitching. On the far right, a bicycle leans against a stone wall, its chain rusty and seat worn. A teenager in a denim jacket stands next to the bicycle, looking at a pocket watch. The watch is open and silver. Behind the teenager, a stack of wooden crates rises high, tied together with rough rope. Perched on the top crate, a small bird preens its feathers, facing left. In the background, a misty hill rises softly, barely visible through the haze. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no modern signage or plastic packaging.
